title: Molly and the Slowest Giant Truck
synopsis: A huge tracked crawler moves the assembled rocket to its pad by the special route while Molly notices the care taken with every movement.
continuity_state: Before: The separate rocket components have been joined and the relevant systems tested; the ground crawler route and pad are prepared. After: Star One stands on its launch support at the pad, crawler withdrawn, and ground systems ready for later checks.
